<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    console.log("Topic selection script loaded");

    const API_BASE_URL =
        "https://uplevel.interviewkickstart.com/api/webinar-slot";

    const container = document.querySelector(".topic_select");
    const radios = container.querySelectorAll("input[type='radio']");

    const optionMap = {
        IP: container.querySelector("#topic_select_option_interview_prep").closest("label"),
        SU: container.querySelector("#topic_select_option_switch_up").closest("label"),
        AGENTIC: container.querySelector("#topic_select_option_agentic_ai").closest("label")
    };

    let lastWebinarType = null;

    /* -----------------------------
       API CALL FUNCTION
    ------------------------------ */
    function callUpcomingSlotsAPI(webinarType) {
        if (!v_country || !v_timezone) {
            console.warn("[API] Missing country or timezone", {
                v_country,
                v_timezone
            });
            return;
        }

        if (webinarType === lastWebinarType) {
            console.log("[API] Skipping duplicate call for:", webinarType);
            return;
        }

        lastWebinarType = webinarType;

        const url =
            `${API_BASE_URL}/upcoming-slots/?` +
            `country=${encodeURIComponent(v_country)}` +
            `&program=Backend` +
            `&timezone=${encodeURIComponent(v_timezone)}` +
            `&type=${encodeURIComponent(webinarType)}`;

        console.log("[API] Calling upcoming slots");
        console.log("[API] URL:", url);

        fetch(url)
            .then(res => res.json())
            .then(data => {
                console.log("[API] Response received:", data);
            })
            .catch(err => {
                console.error("[API] Error:", err);
            });
    }

    /* -----------------------------
       RANDOM DEFAULT SELECTION
    ------------------------------ */
    const rand = Math.random() * 100;

    let selectedKey;
    if (rand < 40) selectedKey = "IP";
    else if (rand < 80) selectedKey = "SU";
    else selectedKey = "AGENTIC";

    radios.forEach(r => r.checked = false);

    const selectedLabel = optionMap[selectedKey];
    const selectedInput = selectedLabel.querySelector("input");

    selectedInput.checked = true;
    container.prepend(selectedLabel);

    // ? Fire API for default selection
    callUpcomingSlotsAPI(
        selectedInput.getAttribute("webinartype")
    );

    /* -----------------------------
       USER CHANGE HANDLER
    ------------------------------ */
    radios.forEach(radio => {
        radio.addEventListener("change", function () {
            if (!this.checked) return;

            callUpcomingSlotsAPI(
                this.getAttribute("webinartype")
            );
        });
    });
});
</script>
